title: Anti-Coworker — Office Observation Log
highlights: 120 desks, 28 slacking behaviours; one 08:30–17:30 workday plays in about 4 minutes
Web Audio stereo panning lets you locate the hiccuping mole by ear
Results are encoded into the URL with a generated share card, no names or nicknames included
No framework, no build step, served as static assets on Cloudflare Workers
summary: A browser observation game set in a government office: tail a coworker, log every way they slack off, then use stereo sound to catch the mole who hiccups like a metronome.
html:
Anti-Coworker — Undercover in a Government Office

Tags: Game, Vanilla JS, Web Audio API, Canvas, Cloudflare Workers

Why

I wanted a game you can open from a link and finish in five minutes, built on an office scene everyone recognises: look busy, quietly watch your coworkers. The observation itself becomes the mechanic, rewarding attention and judgement rather than raw clicking. (The UI is in Traditional Chinese.)

How to play

  1. Pick your seat (gold ring) on the floor plan, then the coworker to log (red 🎯), or use the random buttons.
  2. Press "Start work". The clock runs 08:30 to 17:30 at two minutes per second at 1×, with 2×, 4× and pause.
  3. Read the target's thought bubble, screen colour and where they walk, then press the matching button: bathroom break, phone scrolling, watching stocks, picking up delivery and 28 behaviours in all.
  4. Correct logs score; a wrong press is −5 and a behaviour left unlogged for 8 minutes is −3. Lunch (12:30–13:30) dims the lights and fast-forwards; napping then doesn't count.
  5. Side quest: one coworker is a mole who hiccups frequently and at a fixed interval. Use the hiccup radar timing and left/right audio to find them; you get three accusations, and earlier catches score more.

Design notes

  • Floor plan: ten desk groups A–J, two columns of six each, with the section chief's office and meeting rooms above and restrooms, pantry, copy room and stairwell below; coworkers actually walk there.
  • Layered clues: bubbles, screen colour and destination cross-check each other, so reading labels alone isn't enough.
  • Sound as mechanic: a Web Audio StereoPannerNode pans each hiccup by seat position; the mole's interval is steady while others hiccup in bursts.
  • Mobile: the office shrinks to groups A and B on one screen, log buttons sit at the bottom, with pinch zoom and haptic feedback.
  • Sharing: a rank by score (from rookie snitch to integrity-office legend), results base64url-encoded into the URL and a Canvas share card, deliberately leaving out coworker names and player nicknames.

Tech

  • Plain HTML / CSS / JavaScript in four modules: data (behaviours and ranks), office (floor plan and movement), game (clock, scoring, sound), share (result encoding and card)
  • Animation: a requestAnimationFrame timeline; pause and speed only change the time scale
  • Sound: hiccups synthesised with the Web Audio API, no audio files
  • Storage: seat, target, nicknames, day count and history in localStorage, so you can pick up the next day
  • Hosting: static assets on Cloudflare Workers, no backend, no third-party tracking scripts

Links

  • Play now: https://anti-coworker.delicate-truth-7cd5.workers.dev/

title: 辦公室觀察日誌｜Anti-Coworker
highlights: 120 個座位、28 種摸魚行為，一天 08:30–17:30 約 4 分鐘跑完
Web Audio 立體聲定位：用左右聲道找出規律打嗝的暗樁
成果編碼進網址並產生分享圖卡，不含同事姓名或綽號
零框架、零建置步驟，靜態部署於 Cloudflare Workers
summary: 以公家機關為舞台的網頁觀察小遊戲：盯著同事記錄他在摸什麼魚，再靠聲音方向把打嗝像節拍器的暗樁揪出來。
html:
辦公室觀察日誌 — 公家機關臥底實錄

Tags: Game, Vanilla JS, Web Audio API, Canvas, Cloudflare Workers

緣由

想做一個「打開網址就能玩、玩五分鐘就有結果」的小遊戲，題材取自大家都有共鳴的辦公室日常：表面上認真上班，其實在偷偷觀察同事。把觀察變成需要專注與判斷的遊戲機制，而不是單純的點擊。

怎麼玩

  1. 在辦公室平面圖點選 你的座位（金色圈），再點選 要紀錄的同事（紅色 🎯），或用「隨機座位／隨機同事」。
  2. 按「開始上班」，時鐘從 08:30 走到 17:30；1× 時一秒兩分鐘，可切換 2×／4× 或暫停。
  3. 盯著目標頭上的符號、螢幕顏色與走動路線，判斷他在做什麼，按右側對應按鈕：上廁所、滑手機、盯盤看股票、下樓拿外送……共 28 種行為。
  4. 記對加分、按錯 −5、行為結束 8 分鐘內沒記到算漏記 −3；12:30–13:30 午休關燈不算摸魚，時鐘自動快轉。
  5. 隱藏任務：辦公室藏了一個打嗝「又頻繁又規律」的暗樁。看嗝聲雷達的時間、聽左右聲道方向，用 3 次指認機會把他揪出來，越早抓到分數越高。

設計重點

  • 辦公室平面：A～J 十組座位、每組兩直排各 6 席，上方科長室與會議室、下方廁所／茶水間／影印區／樓梯間，同事會真的走過去。
  • 線索設計：符號泡泡、螢幕顏色、移動目的地三種線索交叉，避免只靠讀字就能答對。
  • 聲音即玩法：用 Web Audio 的 StereoPannerNode 依座位位置調整左右聲道，暗樁的嗝聲間隔固定，其他人則是一陣一陣，玩家可以「聽聲辨位」。
  • 手機版：辦公室精簡為 A、B 兩組，一個畫面看得完；記錄按鈕排在下方，支援雙指縮放與震動回饋。
  • 分享：結算時依分數給稱號（菜鳥抓耙仔 → 政風室傳說），結果以 base64url 編碼進網址並用 Canvas 產生分享圖卡；刻意不放同事姓名或玩家取的綽號。

技術

  • 純 HTML / CSS / JavaScript，四個模組：data（行為與稱號）、office（平面圖與人物移動）、game（時鐘、計分、聲音）、share（成果編碼與圖卡）
  • 動畫：requestAnimationFrame 驅動的時間軸，暫停／倍速只改時間比例
  • 聲音：Web Audio API 合成嗝聲，無外部音檔
  • 儲存：localStorage 保存座位、目標、綽號、天數與歷史紀錄，隔天可以接著玩
  • 部署：Cloudflare Workers 靜態資產，無後端、無第三方追蹤腳本

連結

  • 立即遊玩：https://anti-coworker.delicate-truth-7cd5.workers.dev/

B18 Brand Website — basement18 studio

Tags: Next.js, Vercel, Instagram, UI/UX Design

Brand and world

B18 is basement level 18 on an elevator panel: B for basement, 18 for the eighteen levels of hell in Chinese folk belief, and also a number tied to Guanyin. The label's line is roughly "only hell knows how good heaven is", deconstructing traditional religious symbols with contemporary fashion language to explore human nature.

The logo borrows an elevator floor marker: three blurred, undefinable figures that also spell "B18", standing for the many sides of human nature.

Site structure

  • Home: the B18 STUDIO wordmark with a scrolling tagline, then collections and an Instagram wall.
  • Series: two lines
    • B18 GUANX3: concrete, neon, industrial silhouettes
    • B18 Temple Office (神明事務所): ritual textures, matte blacks, sacred geometry
  • Lookbook: a wall of styled shots, sharing imagery with Instagram.
  • About: brand story, logo concept and designer DK Marc's point of view.
  • Contact: social channels, partner stockists and clothing rental.

Design and experience

  • Dark basement tones, bold condensed headings and red accents make the site feel like stepping down a floor.
  • Images keep their original ratios with no extra decoration, letting garments and graphics speak.
  • Every section has an exit to Instagram: the site explains the brand, Instagram carries daily updates.
  • Mobile first: the first screen is the tagline and two entry points (Explore Series / About the Brand).

Tech

  • Next.js, hosted on Vercel
  • Collections use dynamic routes (/series/[slug])
  • Instagram routing: the gallery and follow buttons link to the official account

title: Kidney Learning — Pediatric CKD Clinic
highlights: Five learning stages: pre-test, teaching clinic, lab reading, clinical reasoning and post-test
100 synthetic patients with 9 judgements each, drawn randomly without repeats
Rule-based simulated-patient interviews record hypotheses, evidence and revisions, scored by teachers on a six-dimension rubric that must quote the learner
Anonymous 2022–2026 score distributions (166 pre-tests, 162 post-tests) as a benchmark
summary: A pediatric chronic kidney disease (CKD) clinical teaching platform for Taipei Veterans General Hospital: pre/post tests, 100 lab-reading cases and rule-based simulated-patient reasoning, with six-dimension teacher scoring and cloud learner accounts.
html:
Kidney Learning — Pediatric CKD Clinic

Tags: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, Vitest, Vercel

Why

Pediatric CKD education often relies on paper handouts and verbal explanation. Clinic time is short, so it is hard to confirm whether learners and families actually learned. The pediatric immunology and nephrology teaching clinic at Taipei Veterans General Hospital wanted a tool, usable in the clinic or after class, that makes learning outcomes visible and comparable. (The UI is in Traditional Chinese.)

The first version was a front-end-only site with a five-question pre/post test; in late 2026 it grew into a full clinical teaching platform.

Learning flow

  1. Pre-test: 15 questions, three in each of five areas (kidney function, CKD staging, common causes, complications, treatment choices).
  2. Teaching clinic: enter patient data, practise staging CKD, and get a clinic report.
  3. Lab reading: 100 synthetic patients. Read growth, kidney and urine, blood pressure and electrolytes, anaemia and bone-mineral values, make 9 judgements, then see the explanation; retry mistakes, download backups and generate reports.
  4. Clinical reasoning: interview a simulated child and mother, recording hypotheses, evidence and revisions at each stage; core labs unlock only after the first reasoning snapshot, practising re-ranking hypotheses on new data.
  5. Post-test: retest to see progress.

Teachers and accounts

  • Learners register cloud accounts with an invite code and submit tests and reasoning to their class; teacher rights are assigned by an admin.
  • The teacher console searches learners, shows raw answer snapshots and scores on a six-dimension rubric; every score must cite the learner's own words, each publish is kept as a new version, and a separate safety review sits outside the average.
  • Legacy local records are never auto-assigned to new accounts, avoiding misattribution.
  • A demo page uses a showcase account and fictional classmates to present tests, clinic reports and teacher reports without exposing real learners (images below are simulated).

Benchmarks and resources

  • Legacy five-question (10-point) scores: 166 pre-tests, mean 6.14 / median 6; 162 post-tests, mean 7.98 / median 8. Shown as distributions and percentile tables, noting that pre/post are unpaired and the unit is attempts, not learners.
  • Resources are grouped by the five areas, linking PubMed papers and guidelines (Schwartz equation, CKiD U25, KDIGO 2024 and more) with source, year and check date.

Tech

  • Front end: Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite, hash routing, lazily loaded pages
  • Back end: Supabase (email accounts, tables and RPCs for classes, invite codes, clinic reports, attempts and score versions)
  • Charts: hand-built SVG radar and distribution components
  • Testing: Vitest, vue-tsc type checking
  • Data prep: Python turns historical spreadsheets into anonymous statistics (distribution, mean, median only)
  • Hosting: Vercel; the footer shows the build version and changelog
  • Models: clinical reasoning uses a rule-based script so replies stay consistent with the case; no generative AI yet

Limitations

  • Simulated patients and labs are synthetic teaching data, not real patients or prevalence, and not for medical use.
  • Practice progress lives in the browser and doesn't sync across devices; submit to the cloud account or download a backup to keep it.
  • Unrecognised questions to the rule-based patient get a neutral reply.

Links

  • Live site: https://frontend-two-chi-30.vercel.app/
  • Source: private repository (not public)

html:
腎入學習 — 兒童 CKD 教學門診

Tags: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, Vitest, Vercel

緣由

兒童慢性腎臟病的衛教多半停留在紙本與口頭說明，門診時間有限，學員與家屬難以確認「學會了沒有」。臺北榮總兒童免疫腎臟科的教學門診希望有一個能在診間或課後使用的工具，讓學習成效可以被看見、被比較，也能作為教學評比的佐證。

第一版是只有五題前後測的純前端網站；2026 下半年擴充成完整的臨床教學平台。

學習流程

  1. 課前檢測：15 題、五大知識面向（腎功能計算、分期判讀、常見病因、合併症辨識、治療選擇）各 3 題，找出自己的起點。
  2. 教學門診：輸入病人數據，練習判讀 CKD 分期，產生門診報告。
  3. 檢驗判讀練習：100 位合成模擬病人，每例先看身高體重、腎功能與尿液、血壓電解質、貧血與骨礦物質等數據，再完成 9 項判斷，提交後看解析；錯題可重練、可下載備份與產生報告。
  4. 臨床推理任務：與模擬病童及母親問診，在不同資訊階段記錄假說、證據與修正；核心檢驗在第一次推理快照後才揭露，練習「依新資料重新排序假說」。
  5. 課後評估：回測檢視自己的進步。

教師端與帳號

  • 學員以 邀請碼 註冊雲端帳號，測驗與推理紀錄完成後可提交到班級；教師資格由管理者指派。
  • 教師後台可搜尋學員、檢視原始作答快照，以 六維量規 評分，給分必須引用學員原文；每次發布保留為新版本，另有不納入平均的「安全覆核」。
  • 舊版本機紀錄不會自動歸屬到新帳號，避免資料錯置。
  • 「功能展示」頁用展示帳號與虛構同學呈現前後測、門診報告與教師報表，不顯示真實學員資料（下圖皆為模擬資料）。

歷史成績與學習資源

  • 舊五題版（滿分 10 分）歷史原始成績：前測 166 筆、平均 6.14／中位數 6；後測 162 筆、平均 7.98／中位數 8。以分布圖與百分位表呈現，並註明前後測非配對、樣本單位是作答筆數。
  • 學習資源依五大面向整理 PubMed 文獻與臨床指引（Schwartz 公式、CKiD U25、KDIGO 2024 等），每筆標註出處、年份與查核日期。

技術

  • 前端：Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite，hash 路由、頁面按需載入
  • 後端：Supabase（Email 帳號、資料表與 RPC：班級、邀請碼、門診報告、作答與評分版本）
  • 圖表：自繪 SVG 雷達圖與分布圖元件
  • 測試：Vitest、vue-tsc 型別檢查
  • 資料處理：Python 把歷史 Excel 轉成匿名統計（僅分布、平均、中位數）
  • 部署：Vercel；頁尾顯示建置版本與更新歷程
  • 模型：臨床推理使用 規則式腳本，確保回覆與病例設定一致，尚未連接生成式 AI

限制

  • 模擬病人與檢驗資料為純合成教學資料，非真實病人或盛行率，不作醫療用途。
  • 練習進度存在瀏覽器，跨裝置不同步；需要保存的紀錄要提交到雲端帳號或下載備份。
  • 規則式問診遇到未辨識的問句只會給中性回覆。

title: Transcript Plus
summary: A local-first desktop app that turns recordings into editable transcripts, then subtitles and meeting notes, fully offline.
html:
Transcript Plus — Local Subtitle and Meeting Notes App

Tags: Tauri, React, Python, SQLite, Whisper, Offline

Currently a v0.1 development build: the desktop UI, local Python transcription core, SQLite storage, transcript editing and subtitle export are implemented. A macOS .app builds locally, but it is not a full MVP yet, and Windows hardware and public release are unverified.

Why

The idea came from speech-related development work: the real time sink turned out to be the manual work between "recognition finished" and "transcript ready": proofreading, line-breaking and timing, and few tools cover that whole stretch. Interviews, meetings and lessons also often contain sensitive material that should not go to the cloud. So I set out to try an installable single-machine app where data and inference never leave the computer.

Goals and intended effect

  • Take interviewers, podcasters, educators and meeting note-takers from a local media file to publishable subtitles.
  • Cut proofreading time: the target is at least 30% lower median subtitle-prep time on the same material (a planning target, not yet validated).
  • Work fully offline once models are in place, with no sign-up and no self-hosted server.
  • One transcript dataset yields TXT, SRT, VTT and JSON, plus (planned) summaries and action items.

How it was built

  1. Wrote the MVP requirements, acceptance metrics and architecture first to settle scope and tech choices, then built milestone by milestone.
  2. Architecture: Tauri 2 shell, React front end, Python sidecar core packaged with PyInstaller so users need no dev environment.
  3. A structured Transcript / Word / Cue data contract at the center; SQLite is the single writable source of truth and subtitle files are derived output.
  4. Persistent job queue with stage state, cancel and retry, autosave and undo/redo; invalidated word timings are flagged for review rather than faked.
  5. Two-hour transcripts render through a virtual list to keep editing responsive.

Done: media import and playback, local transcription with word timings, subtitle generation / split / merge / timing tweaks, TXT / SRT / VTT / JSON export. Not yet: automatic speaker diarization, local summaries and action items, video proxy, model download management, code signing and notarization.

Packages and models

  • Desktop: Tauri 2 (Rust), React 19, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Virtual, Lucide
  • Core: Python 3.12, SQLite, PyInstaller
  • ASR: faster-whisper (CTranslate2, CPU INT8); MLX Whisper on Apple Silicon
  • Models: Breeze ASR (tuned for Taiwanese Mandarin) or Whisper-family models, from a local folder the user picks; the app never downloads weights itself
  • Planned: sherpa-onnx speaker diarization, local LLM summaries and action items
  • Testing: pytest, Vitest, Testing Library
  • Media: FFmpeg / ffprobe

Links

  • Source and README: https://github.com/awtw/transcript-plus

title: Transcript Plus
summary: 以逐字稿為核心的本機字幕與會議整理桌面軟體，離線轉錄、校對並匯出 SRT／VTT。
html:
Transcript Plus — 本機字幕與會議整理軟體

Tags: Tauri, React, Python, SQLite, Whisper, Offline

目前為 v0.1 開發版：已實作桌面介面、Python 本機轉錄核心、SQLite 儲存、逐字稿校對與字幕匯出；macOS 已可建置 .app，尚非完整 MVP，Windows 實機與公開發行尚未驗收。

緣由

靈感來自工作上開發語音相關功能的經驗：發現真正耗時的不是辨識本身，而是「辨識完成到整理完成」之間的人工校對、斷句與對時，市面上也少有能完整銜接這段流程的工具。同時，訪談、會議與課程錄音常含敏感內容，不適合上傳雲端。因此決定自己嘗試做成可安裝的單機軟體，資料與推論都留在電腦。

目的與預期效果

  • 讓訪談、Podcast、課程與會議整理者，從本機影音一路做到可發布字幕。
  • 縮短校對時間：目標是在相同素材下，字幕整理時間中位數減少 30% 以上（規劃目標，尚未達標驗證）。
  • 全程離線可用，模型備齊後可斷網工作，無註冊登入與自建伺服器。
  • 同一份逐字稿資料同時產出 TXT、SRT、VTT、JSON，以及（規劃中）摘要與待辦。

如何做出來

  1. 先撰寫 MVP 需求、驗收指標與架構文件，釐清範圍與技術選型，再依里程碑逐步實作。
  2. 架構採 Tauri 2 桌面外殼、React 前端、Python sidecar 核心，以 PyInstaller 封裝，使用者不需自備開發環境。
  3. 以結構化 Transcript／Word／Cue 資料契約為核心，SQLite 為唯一可寫事實來源，字幕檔只是衍生輸出。
  4. 持久化工作佇列與階段狀態，支援取消、重試、自動儲存與復原／重做；字詞時間失效時明示待核對，不假裝有效。
  5. 2 小時逐字稿以虛擬清單呈現，維持編輯流暢度。

已完成：影音匯入與播放、本機轉錄與詞時間、字幕生成／拆合／時間微調、TXT／SRT／VTT／JSON 匯出。 尚未提供：自動講者分離、本機摘要與待辦、影片代理、模型下載管理、簽章與公證。

使用的套件與模型

  • 桌面：Tauri 2（Rust）、React 19、TypeScript、Vite、TanStack Virtual、Lucide
  • 核心：Python 3.12、SQLite、PyInstaller
  • 語音辨識：faster-whisper（CTranslate2，CPU INT8）；Apple Silicon 另支援 MLX Whisper
  • 模型：Breeze ASR（台灣華語優化）／Whisper 系列，由使用者自行指定本機模型資料夾，程式不自動下載權重
  • 規劃中：sherpa-onnx 講者分離、本機 LLM 摘要與待辦
  • 測試：pytest、Vitest、Testing Library
  • 媒體處理：FFmpeg／ffprobe

html:
YES Financial System — Fund Analytics & Data Pipeline

Tags: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Cron, Vercel

Why

Advisers explaining policy-linked funds to clients kept jumping between fund-house sites, MoneyDJ and spreadsheets. The deeper problem was unsynchronised sources: funds, ETFs, stocks and indices trade on different days, so fetching live in the browser or mixing sources breaks charts, makes dividend figures disagree and leaves performance unauditable.

YES moves collection, field mapping and source-value storage into back-end cron jobs, leaving the front end to present and explain. (The UI is in Traditional Chinese.)

Features

  • Fund overview: filter by 20-plus fund houses (Allianz, BlackRock, PIMCO, JPMorgan, Schroder, CTBC and more) and search; shows cumulative return, CAGR, annualised dividend yield and max drawdown, with NAV charted against the S&P 500 and TAIEX.
  • Dividend cash flow: enter units held to see per-unit payouts, annualised yield and estimated cash per ex-date, listing both the source yield and the formula yield.
  • Investment simulator: lump sum or monthly, 1–40 years, growth from the fund's historical CAGR or conservative / aggressive scenarios, up to five comparison funds, and a printable proposal.
  • Member CRM: Supabase-backed members with status (active / lead / inactive), owner, channel, notes and linked funds.

Data pipeline (Pipeline Observatory)

A dedicated page explains where data comes from, how it is judged and how often it refreshes, labelling what runs today versus what is still spec (LIVE / HYBRID):

  1. Source master and whitelist: the fund whitelist and universe bootstrap decide which funds, ETFs, stocks and indices to track.
  2. Core fund sync: MoneyDJ for fund NAV and dividends, Yahoo for required ETFs; name normalisation plus verified code overrides pick the most trustworthy match, with a 0.82 score threshold.
  3. Expansion instruments: candidates are written to instruments and a source map, then Yahoo daily bars fill daily NAV.
  4. Status write-back: each instrument records ok / partial / failed / pending, last success time and failure reason, read directly by the dashboard and pipeline page.
  5. Formulas and performance: the annualised-yield formula is live; the authoritative adjusted-NAV and CAGR batch is still planned.

The page reads Supabase report snapshots (last sync, success and failure counts, instruments to investigate and why), all read-only.

Tech

  • Front end: Next.js + TypeScript, dark dashboard UI, hosted on Vercel
  • Database and auth: Supabase (funds, NAV, dividends, instrument master, source map, sync status, members and notes)
  • Collection: scheduled crawlers (crawl:required-real, sync:universe-instruments, crawl:universe-daily) over MoneyDJ and Yahoo Finance
  • Quality: dividend-formula reconciliation, sync report snapshots, daily checkpoints (batch size and lookback window)

Limitations

  • Old and new schemas run side by side during migration; some charts still read the legacy tables and add the new status fields.
  • The authoritative adjusted-NAV and CAGR batch isn't live yet; performance uses existing NAV.
  • Sign-in required; figures are for internal analysis and client conversations, not investment advice.

Links

  • App (sign-in required): https://yes.fms.8plus.app/

html:
YES 財務管理系統 — 基金分析與資料管線

Tags: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Cron, Vercel

緣由

顧問向客戶說明保單連結的基金時，常要在各家投信網站、MoneyDJ 與 Excel 之間來回切換。更根本的問題是資料源彼此不同步：基金、ETF、股票與大盤的交易日不同，前端若直接即時抓資料或混用來源，圖表會斷線、配息口徑會打架，績效也無法稽核。

YES 的做法是把資料採集、欄位轉換與來源值保存放進後端 cronjob，前端只負責展示與解釋。

主要功能

  • 基金總覽：依資料來源（Allianz、BlackRock、PIMCO、JPMorgan、Schroder、CTBC 等 20 多家）篩選與搜尋，顯示累積報酬、年化報酬（CAGR）、年化配息率與最大回撤，淨值走勢可對照 S&P 500、台灣加權指數。
  • 配息現金流：輸入持有單位數，看每次除息的每單位配息、年化配息率與預估領取現金；年化配息率同時列出「來源值」與「公式值」。
  • 投資試算：單筆投入或每月定額，1–40 年試算，成長率可用主標的歷史 CAGR 或保守／積極情境，最多再加 5 檔基金比較，並可列印試算建議書。
  • 會員 CRM：以 Supabase 管理會員、狀態（active／lead／inactive）、負責人、來源渠道與備註，並關聯追蹤的基金。

資料管線（Pipeline Observatory）

系統另有一頁公開說明資料怎麼來、怎麼判斷、多久更新，把「現在真的怎麼跑」和「規劃中的規格」分開標示（LIVE／HYBRID）：

  1. 來源主檔與白名單：從基金白名單與 universe bootstrap 決定要追蹤哪些基金、ETF、股票與指數。
  2. 核心基金同步：MoneyDJ 抓基金淨值與配息、Yahoo 抓必要 ETF；以名稱正規化與人工驗證的代碼對照幫每檔找最可信的配對，分數門檻 0.82。
  3. 擴展標的建檔：候選標的寫入 instruments 與來源對照表，再用 Yahoo 日線補齊每日淨值。
  4. 狀態回寫：每檔標的記錄 ok／partial／failed／pending、最後成功時間與失敗原因，首頁與管線頁直接讀取。
  5. 公式與績效：年化配息率公式已實作；adjusted NAV 與 CAGR 的權威批次仍在規劃中。

頁面會讀取 Supabase 的報告快照：最近一次同步時間、成功／失敗筆數、待排查標的與失敗原因，全部唯讀、不觸發寫入。

技術

  • 前端：Next.js + TypeScript，深色儀表板介面，部署於 Vercel
  • 資料庫與帳號：Supabase（基金、淨值、配息、標的主檔、來源對照、同步狀態、會員與備註）
  • 資料採集：排程爬蟲（crawl:required-real、sync:universe-instruments、crawl:universe-daily），來源為 MoneyDJ 與 Yahoo Finance
  • 品質控管：配息公式對帳、同步報告快照、每日 checkpoint（批次大小與回溯天數）

限制

  • 新舊兩套資料表並行過渡中，部分圖表仍讀舊表，再補讀新的狀態欄位。
  • adjusted NAV 與 CAGR 權威批次尚未上線，目前績效以既有淨值計算。
  • 系統需登入使用，資料僅供內部分析與客戶溝通，不構成投資建議。

連結

  • 系統入口（需登入）：https://yes.fms.8plus.app/
